name: WorldData Core Test
description: WorldData Core Test (WDCT) is the test and benchmark mod for WorldData Core. It runs a repeatable synthetic workload (ATM_PACK V1) against the Core's public read API, times it against plain Minecraft, and checks the Core's data against the live world. It also has ramp and efficiency tests, a per-tick time budget and an optional ops-per-second cap, and one launch can run on either the Core or plain Minecraft. It works in any dimension, including custom ones, and with modded blocks and biomes. Not a gameplay mod: use a throwaway world. Reports are written to the game folder.
